title: Slider
description: The backlight slider module displays and controls the current brightness of the default or preferred device.

min.label: Min
min.doc: The minimum volume value the slider should display and set.
min.description: The minimum volume value the slider should display and set.

max.label: Max
max.doc: The maximum volume value the slider should display and set.
max.description: The maximum volume value the slider should display and set.

orientation.label: Orientation
orientation.doc: The orientation of the slider. Can be either horizontal or vertical.
orientation.description: The orientation of the slider. Can be either horizontal or vertical.

device.label: Device
device.doc: The name of the preferred device to control. If left empty, a device will be chosen automatically. Both screen backlights (the udev backlight subsystem) and keyboard backlights (LEDs in the udev leds subsystem, e.g. white:kbd_backlight) are supported; name such an LED here to control it. When left empty, a screen backlight is always preferred for automatic selection.
device.description: The name of the preferred device to control. If left empty, a device will be chosen automatically. Both screen backlights (the udev backlight subsystem) and keyboard backlights (LEDs in the udev leds subsystem, e.g. white:kbd_backlight) are supported; name such an LED here to control it. When left empty, a screen backlight is always preferred for automatic selection.

interval.label: Refresh every
interval.doc: The interval in milliseconds at which the brightness is polled and the slider is updated.
interval.description: How often the module updates its information.

expand.label: Fill empty space
expand.doc: Enables this module to consume all left over space dynamically.
expand.description: Stretch the module to use all the free space left in its section.
